fields.summary: Timeout setting ignored for streaming downloads
fields.description:
Setting a read timeout has no effect when streaming a response body.

h2. Steps to Reproduce
# Create a client with {{timeout=1}}
# Stream [a slow endpoint|https://slow.example.com/drip]
# Wait

{code:python}
with client.stream("GET", url) as r:
    for chunk in r.iter_bytes():
        pass
{code}

h2. Expected Behavior
A timeout error after about 1 second.

h2. Actual Behavior
The download hangs for minutes.
